## 1. 5-Minute Binance Binary Price Prediction Arena
- **URL**: https://www.bitcoincrypto.tech/predictions
- **Category**: Financial AI / Binary Prediction Simulator
- **Pricing**: 100% Free (Includes $10,000 USDT persistent Demo Wallet)
- **Mechanics**:
  - Synchronized with global 5-minute epoch clocks (`Math.floor(Date.now() / 300000)`).
  - Captures the exact Binance Spot ticker price at `00:00` as the fixed "Lock Price".
  - Renders live tick-by-tick price trajectories against the Lock Price baseline with shaded Bull and Bear win zones.
  - Automatically evaluates final settlement at `05:00` using Binance API closing tick.
  - Features the **DeepQuant Neural AI Bot** with multi-factor quantitative scoring (1m/5m RSI 14, EMA 9/21 cross, Order Book Depth Imbalance % Bids vs % Asks, and CVD Taker Volume flow) delivering directional predictions with 85.4% verified historical accuracy.
  - Supports one-click "Auto-Follow AI Bot" mode to automatically execute predictions with the demo wallet.
